<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"><font size="2">The Company is experiencing illiquidity and has been dependent upon shareholders to provide funds to maintain its activities.
The shareholders have provided $1,428,347 to September 30, 2002, and were repaid $53,230 during 1999, $1,009,889 in 2000, and
$325,579 in 2001, leaving a balance of $39,649, which is included in accounts payable.  There are no specific terms of repayment.
</font></p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"> </p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p>
<p span style="margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1">&nbsp;</p span>
<p span style="margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1"><font size="2">(b) Capital
Resources</font></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify; margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1">
<p span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1">
<p span style="font-size: 11pt; margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1">
<p span style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"><font size="2">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"><font size="2">The Company had a working capital deficiency of $207,481 at September 30, 2002. As noted above, the Company is
receiving funding from shareholders.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p>
<p style="text-align: justify; margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1">
<p span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1">
<p span style="margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1">&nbsp;</p span>
<p span style="margin-top:1; margin-bottom:1"><font size="2">(c)  Results of Operations</font></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"><font size="2">&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"><font size="2">For the nine-months ended September 30, 2002, the Company incurred a net loss of $39,964.</font></p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p span>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"></p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"><font size="2">Administration expenses for the nine-month period amounted to $39,964, compared to $226,393 in the same period of 2001.
</font></p>
<p style="margin-top: 1; margin-bottom: 1"> </p span>

    &nbsp;&nbsp;</font></td>
    <td vAlign="top" bordercolor="#FFFFFF" style="border: 1px solid #FFFFFF">
    <font face="Times New Roman, Times, serif" size="2">I am
    responsible for establishing and maintaining disclosure controls and
    procedures (as defined in Exchange Act Rules 13a-14 and 15d-14) for the
    registrant and have designed such disclosure controls and procedures to
    ensure that material information relating to the Company is made known to me
    by others, particularly during the period in which this quarterly report is
    being prepared;<br>
&nbsp;</font></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td vAlign="top" width="5%" bordercolor="#FFFFFF" style="border: 1px solid #FFFFFF">

    have disclosed, based on my most recent evaluation, to the Company's
    auditors and the audit committee of our board of directors (or persons
    performing the equivalent functions):<br>
&nbsp;</font></td>
  </tr>

  <tr>
    <td width="5%" bordercolor="#FFFFFF" style="border: 1px solid #FFFFFF">

    <font face="Times New Roman, Times, serif" size="2">All significant
